title: Ashurst in Australia Wins 2013 Legal Award
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: The strong Intellectual Property team at Ashurst is acting for Samsung in its dispute with Apple. The lawyers here are very experienced and led by a highly effective litigator.  The IP group in Australia provides a full range of services and the firm rightly prides itself on its global presence and impressive industry sector coverage. Ashurst LLP is our award for ‘Best IP Team’, Australia, 2013.
